### `text_version` (TXT-n)

One version of a long text field: its text (stored once by hash in the workspace's texts folder), where it came from, whether it is waiting for review, and who wrote each passage. Written by the text ops and `writer.set_text`; the person accepts or discards pending ones.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `owner_kind` | str | required | The kind of the record whose field this is a version of. |
| `owner_id` | str | required | The id of that record. |
| `field` | str | required | The long text field. |
| `number` | int | required | The version's number for this field: 1, 2, 3...; never reused. |
| `sha256` | str | required | Hash of the text; also where it is stored. |
| `format` | str | required | The text format its units come from. |
| `words` | int | `0` | How many words it has. |
| `source` | Literal['edit', 'draft', 'proposal', 'merge', 'import'] | required | edit: the person wrote it here. draft: the assistant wrote it. proposal: the person's own work arriving from outside (a working copy, a file). merge: the result of accepting changes. import: loaded by a person's action. |
| `status` | Literal['pending', 'accepted', 'merged', 'discarded'] | required | pending: waiting for review. accepted: it became the field's text. merged: some of its changes were accepted into a newer version. discarded: set aside. |
| `base` | int \| None | `None` | The number of the version it was made from. |
| `replaces` | int \| None | `None` | For an accepted version, the number of the one it replaced. |
| `authorship` | list[dict[str, Any]] | `[]` | Who wrote each passage: {start, end, kind, run}, kind person, assistant (drafted) or assistant_edit (the person's text changed by the assistant), with the AI run for the assistant's. |
| `paragraph_map` | list[dict[str, Any]] | `[]` | For an anchored draft, which base units each new unit came from. |
| `note` | str \| None | `None` | Where it came from, in words, when that helps the review. |
| `unmapped` | list[str] | `[]` | For a version taken back from a working copy, what the format couldn't map, shown beside it. |
| `questions` | list[str] | `[]` | For a draft, the questions for the person it ended with, shown beside it. |
| `run` | str \| None | `None` | The AI run that wrote it, for a draft. |
| `created_at` | datetime | required | When it was written. |

### `working_copy` (WC-n)

A long text field handed out as a file for the person's own tool (a word processor), and what came back. The host writes it when the person hands a field out or brings a file back.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `owner_kind` | str | required | The kind of the record whose field was handed out. |
| `owner_id` | str | required | That record's id. |
| `field` | str | required | The long text field. |
| `format` | str | required | The working-copy format that made the file. |
| `base` | int \| None | `None` | The number of the version handed out; none if the field was empty. |
| `file` | str | required | The id of the file handed out. |
| `sha256` | str | required | Hash of the file handed out, to tell an untouched one. |
| `status` | Literal['out', 'returned', 'dropped'] | `'out'` | out: handed out. returned: a file came back as a proposal. dropped: set aside by the person. |
| `returned_file` | str \| None | `None` | The id of the last file brought back. |
| `proposal` | str \| None | `None` | The id of the text version the last file back became. |
| `handed_at` | datetime | required | When it was handed out. |
| `returned_at` | datetime.datetime \| None | `None` | When a file last came back. |

### `value_list` (LIST-n)

A list of the values a field may take, shown as a dropdown (design 5.1). The core and plugins ship its first values; the person adds, renames and retires values with `list.add`, `list.rename` and `list.retire`. A retired value is no longer offered, and records that have it keep it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | required | The list's id: "project-status", or "<plugin>/<name>" for a plugin's list. |
| `label` | str | required | What the list is called on screen. |
| `values` | list[str] | `[]` | The values offered, in the order shown. |
| `retired` | list[str] | `[]` | Values no longer offered that records may still hold. |

## Core ops

Fields of each core op, for actions and task kinds that use them.

### `action.add`

A new action: something a person will do. Owners are people (name or id); leave empty if nobody is named. With no owner the action is held and the PM is asked to pick one. Evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | A verb that does something, e.g. 'Send the final file to the printer'. |
| `owners` | list[str] | `[]` | The people who do it, each by name or id; empty if nobody is named. A name that isn't one known person waits for the PM to say who. |
| `due` | datetime.date \| None | `None` | The day it is due, if one is stated. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | Project id, if the action belongs to one. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `action.close`

Close an open action the input says is done. Refused if the action doesn't exist or is already done; evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the open action that is done. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `action.drop`

Drop an action that is no longer needed, with the reason. It stays on record as dropped: never done, never credited to its owners, never chased, and gone from to-do lists. Refused if the action doesn't exist or is already done or dropped; evidence is required (the input's words, or the person's note).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the action that is no longer needed. |
| `reason` | str | required | Why it is no longer needed, in plain words. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input that justify this op; required unless the person makes it. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `action.hold`

Put an open action on hold: it waits for something outside the person's control and is never due, overdue or chased while it does. Say what it waits for in plain words. Refused if the action doesn't exist or isn't open; evidence is required (the input's words, or the person's note).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the open action to put on hold. |
| `waiting_for` | str | required | What it waits for, in plain words. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input that justify this op; required unless the person makes it. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `action.unhold`

Take an action off hold when the input says the thing it was waiting for has happened: it is due, chased and shown again by its own due date. Refused if the action doesn't exist, isn't open or isn't on hold; evidence is required (the input's words, or the person's note).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the action that is on hold and no longer waits. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input that justify this op; required unless the person makes it. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `answer`

Answer the PM's question from the material given: the user guide, the settings, what this install can do and the records. Every claim the answer makes cites the exact words it comes from. Creates an answer record.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | The answer, in plain words, for the PM. |
| `cites` | list[EvidenceIn] | required | The exact words from the material that the answer rests on. |
| `cites[].quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `event.add`

A date or a range of dates the input gives for something (a delivery window, a deadline, an appointment, a launch), in the app's own calendar. Beside the fact or action it belongs to, with the same quoted words. Dates only as the input states them; evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `title` | str | required | What happens on that date, in a few words. |
| `start` | str | required | The day it starts, written YYYY-MM-DD, or a date-time with its offset when the input gives a time. |
| `end` | str \| None | `None` | The last day of a range (or the end time), in the same form as start; leave out for one day. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | Project id, if the entry belongs to one. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn | required | The exact words from the input that give the date. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `fact`

Record something the input states as true. Creates a fact record; evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | The fact, as a statement. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | Project id, if the fact is about one. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |
| `key` | bool | `False` | True only for a fact that matters most to the project; it is shown first. |
| `as_of` | datetime.date \| None | `None` | The day the fact was true as of, written YYYY-MM-DD, when the input or the person's note names one (a note often reports something said earlier); left out, it is the day the input was received or the note was typed. |
| `supersedes` | str \| None | `None` | The id of an existing fact this one replaces (the same thing, newer). The older fact stays on record. |
| `basis` | Optional[Literal['inferred', 'said']] | `None` | Who the fact rests on, when it isn't what the input's origin says (leave it out then: the person's own note is the person's word, and content from outside is said by its sender). inferred: the input doesn't say this outright; you worked it out from the words you quote. said: someone else said it, named in said_by. |
| `said_by` | str \| None | `None` | With basis said: who said it, by name or id, when the input names someone. |
| `reaches_children` | bool | `False` | True only for a fact about a project that holds for every project inside it too (a fact about a series that is true of each of its books); needs the project. Left false, it is about that project alone. |

### `file.add`

Record a file whose bytes the host already stored under their hash, such as one a person action built. Only person actions offer it; Undo removes the record (the bytes stay, unused). The record is marked untrusted and as written by a program.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id the host set aside for this file. |
| `name` | str | required | The file's name, for showing and downloading. |
| `media_type` | str | required | What kind of content it is, such as image/png. |
| `size` | int | required | Size in bytes; it must match the stored bytes. |
| `sha256` | str | required | Hash of the bytes, which must already be stored. |
| `file_kind` | str | `'attachment'` | What the file is for: the core's attachment or a declared kind. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | The project it belongs to; none means the whole workspace. |
| `meta` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Details the file kind asks for, validated on add. |
| `replaces` | str \| None | `None` | The earlier file this one is a new version of. |

### `glossary.add`

Keep a glossary entry: a term or acronym and what it means here. From the person's own words it is active at once; from anything else it is a proposal the person keeps or discards.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | The entry in plain words, such as the term and what it stands for. |
| `term` | str | required | The term, acronym or name as it is written. |
| `meaning` | str | required | What it means. |
| `confidence` | Literal['confirmed', 'assumed', 'unknown'] | `'assumed'` | confirmed: someone who knows said so. assumed: a reasonable reading. unknown: not yet. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | Project id, if the term is about one project only. |
| `id_patterns` | list[str] | `[]` | Patterns for splitting compound ids that use the term. |
| `applies_to` | Scope | see below | What it applies to. |
| `applies_to.task_kinds` | list[str] | `[]` | Task kinds it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.records` | list[str] | `[]` | Record types or type.field targets it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.filter` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Exact field values narrowing the record targets. |
| `applies_to.projects` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope projects, the projects it is for. |
| `applies_to.people` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='person')]] | `[]` | The people it is about; empty means anyone. |
| `applies_to.scope` | Literal['workspace', 'projects'] | `'workspace'` | workspace: everywhere, except the projects in `except`. projects: only the projects listed in `projects`. |
| `applies_to.except` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope workspace, the projects it does not apply to. Dumped by alias, so the key is `except`. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input it rests on, if any. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `glossary.update`

Change a glossary entry that is proposed or active. A system op: from anyone but the person it waits for them. Name only what changes.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the glossary entry. |
| `text` | str \| None | `None` | The new wording. |
| `meaning` | str \| None | `None` | The new meaning. |
| `confidence` | Optional[Literal['confirmed', 'assumed', 'unknown']] | `None` | The new confidence. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | The project it is about. |
| `id_patterns` | list[str] \| None | `None` | The new patterns for splitting compound ids. |
| `applies_to` | Scope \| None | see below | What it now applies to, in full. |
| `applies_to.task_kinds` | list[str] | `[]` | Task kinds it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.records` | list[str] | `[]` | Record types or type.field targets it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.filter` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Exact field values narrowing the record targets. |
| `applies_to.projects` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope projects, the projects it is for. |
| `applies_to.people` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='person')]] | `[]` | The people it is about; empty means anyone. |
| `applies_to.scope` | Literal['workspace', 'projects'] | `'workspace'` | workspace: everywhere, except the projects in `except`. projects: only the projects listed in `projects`. |
| `applies_to.except` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope workspace, the projects it does not apply to. Dumped by alias, so the key is `except`. |

### `knowledge.retire`

Retire an active lesson, glossary entry, routing entry or style note, named by its id: it stops guiding runs and stays on record. A system op: from anyone but the person it waits for them.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the entry, such as a lesson's. |

### `lesson.add`

Keep a lesson: what went wrong, why, and the guard that stops it happening again, written as the general case in plain words. From the person's own words it is active at once; from anything else it is a proposal the person keeps or discards, and changes nothing until kept. `signal` is the correction it came from.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | The lesson in plain words, as the general case. |
| `guard` | str \| None | `None` | The check or behavior that prevents a repeat, in plain words. |
| `signal` | str \| None | `None` | The id of the correction it came from, if there is one. |
| `applies_to` | Scope | see below | What it applies to. |
| `applies_to.task_kinds` | list[str] | `[]` | Task kinds it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.records` | list[str] | `[]` | Record types or type.field targets it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.filter` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Exact field values narrowing the record targets. |
| `applies_to.projects` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope projects, the projects it is for. |
| `applies_to.people` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='person')]] | `[]` | The people it is about; empty means anyone. |
| `applies_to.scope` | Literal['workspace', 'projects'] | `'workspace'` | workspace: everywhere, except the projects in `except`. projects: only the projects listed in `projects`. |
| `applies_to.except` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope workspace, the projects it does not apply to. Dumped by alias, so the key is `except`. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input it rests on, if any. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `lesson.update`

Change a lesson that is proposed or active: its wording, its guard or what it applies to. A system op: it changes how the assistant behaves, so from anyone but the person it waits for them. Name only what changes.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the lesson. |
| `text` | str \| None | `None` | The new wording. |
| `guard` | str \| None | `None` | The new guard. |
| `applies_to` | Scope \| None | see below | What it now applies to, in full. |
| `applies_to.task_kinds` | list[str] | `[]` | Task kinds it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.records` | list[str] | `[]` | Record types or type.field targets it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.filter` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Exact field values narrowing the record targets. |
| `applies_to.projects` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope projects, the projects it is for. |
| `applies_to.people` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='person')]] | `[]` | The people it is about; empty means anyone. |
| `applies_to.scope` | Literal['workspace', 'projects'] | `'workspace'` | workspace: everywhere, except the projects in `except`. projects: only the projects listed in `projects`. |
| `applies_to.except` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope workspace, the projects it does not apply to. Dumped by alias, so the key is `except`. |

### `list.add`

Add a value to a value list, or offer a retired one again. A system op: from the assistant it waits for the person.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `list` | str | required | The list's name, such as "project-status". |
| `value` | str | required | The value to offer. |

### `list.merge`

Merge one value of a value list into another: every record that holds the first now holds the second, and the first leaves the list. A system op: from the assistant it waits for the person.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `list` | str | required | The list's name. |
| `value` | str | required | The value that goes away. |
| `into` | str | required | The value that stays and takes its place. |

### `list.rename`

Rename a value on a list and on every record that holds it, in one step.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `list` | str | required | The list's name. |
| `value` | str | required | The value as it is now. |
| `to` | str | required | Its new wording. |

### `list.retire`

Stop offering a value; records that hold it keep it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `list` | str | required | The list's name. |
| `value` | str | required | The value to stop offering. |

### `mail.restore`

Bring back a mail item that was set aside as not work: it leaves the Set aside folder and the assistant reads it. A system op: from the assistant it waits for the person.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `snapshot` | str | required | The id of the set-aside mail item. |

### `note`

Keep something from the input that isn't a fact, action or question. Creates a note record.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | What to keep. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | Project id, if the note is about one. |
| `question` | str \| None | `None` | The id of the open question it adds to, when the input says more about one. |

### `person.add`

Someone the input names who isn't on file yet. From outside content it waits for the PM to confirm.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `full_name` | str | required | The person's full name. |
| `role` | str \| None | `None` | Their job or part in the work, if stated. |
| `org` | str \| None | `None` | The organization they work for, if stated. |
| `aliases` | list[str] | `[]` | Other names the input uses for them. |
| `first_name` | str \| None | `None` | The name a greeting to them uses, if the input shows how they sign it. |

### `person.contact`

A way to reach a person that the input gives, such as a phone number or an address in their signature. It always waits for the person to confirm it, whoever proposes it: a detail from outside content would otherwise become a way to reach someone. Confirming sets the detail of that kind on the person, replacing one of the same kind. The kind is one of the contact kinds the workspace offers; evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `person` | str | required | The id of the person the detail belongs to. |
| `kind` | str | required | What the detail is: one of the contact kinds listed in the request. |
| `value` | str | required | The detail itself, as the input gives it. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input that give it; required unless the person makes it. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `project.add`

Start a new project, optionally inside another (a book in its series). A system op: from the assistant it waits for the person. The name must not be another live project's.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `name` | str | required | The project's name. |
| `summary` | str \| None | `None` | A short description of what the project is. |
| `parent` | str \| None | `None` | The id of the project it belongs to, if any. |
| `language` | str \| None | `None` | Its language tag, if it differs from its parent's or the workspace's. |
| `children` | list[str] | `[]` | Ids of existing projects to move inside the new one (books into a new series), in the same op. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input that name the project, when an input is where it came from. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `project.role`

Set a person's part in a project: they run it, design for it, or only watch it. Propose it when the input says who runs, designs or watches a project now ("I'm running it now", "they want me to take it over"). A system op: from the assistant it waits for the person, who may set it on the project's own page. Evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `project` | str | required | The id of the project the role is on. |
| `person` | str | required | The person whose part it is, by name or id. |
| `role` | Literal['run', 'design', 'watch'] | required | run: they run it. design: they design for it. watch: they only watch it, so only facts are recorded about it. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input that say it; required unless the person makes it. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `question.add`

A question for a person, written for its reader. A decision is a question to whoever decides, the PM when nobody is named. A question to anyone else needs at least one link the recipient can open.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `to` | str | required | The person, by name or id. |
| `title` | str | required | The question in one line. |
| `text` | str | `''` | The detail the reader needs to answer. |
| `links` | list[LinkIn] | `[]` | Pages the reader can open to see what it is about. |
| `links[].label` | str | required | What the link is, in words for the reader. |
| `links[].url` | str | required | The address to open; a question to someone else needs one the recipient can open. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | Project id, if the question is about one. |
| `kind` | Literal['question', 'decision'] | `'question'` | question: an ordinary question. decision: a choice for whoever decides, the PM when nobody is named. |
| `matters_for` | str \| None | `None` | For a question to anyone but the PM: which of the PM's decisions, designs or dated items depends on the answer, by id or in words. Without one the question isn't asked: record it as a fact instead and say so in the change's note. |

### `question.done`

Record the answer to an open question and close it. Also records the answer as a fact. Refused if the question doesn't exist or is already closed; evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the open question that was answered. |
| `answer` | str | required | The answer, in words. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `question.drop`

Drop a question that isn't needed, with the reason. It stays on record as dropped; Undo opens it again. Use it only when the input or the person's note says the question is no longer needed; evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the question. |
| `reason` | str | required | Why it is dropped, in plain words. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input that justify this op; required unless the person makes it. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `question.mark_sent`

Record that the person already sent an open question themselves, the day they did (today when left out). The person uses it, or the assistant when the person's own note says they asked; Undo makes it open again.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the open question. |
| `on` | datetime.date \| None | `None` | The day it was sent, written YYYY-MM-DD; today when left out. |

### `question.move`

Ask someone else instead: the question goes to another person, by name or id, and keeps its kind: a decision stays a decision for the new person. Only the person uses it; Undo sends it back to the one it was for.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the question. |
| `to` | str | required | The person it goes to now, by name or id. |

### `question.update`

Reword a question: its title, its text or both. Only the person uses it; Undo puts the old wording back.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the question. |
| `title` | str \| None | `None` | The new title. |
| `text` | str \| None | `None` | The new text. |

### `record.delete`

Delete a record. Refused while another live record refers to it, or if it changed since it was read; Undo brings it back. A system op: from the assistant it waits for the person; never part of extracting notes.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record to delete. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The version of the record that was read; the delete fails if it changed. |

### `record.edit`

The person's own change to fields of any record (core or a plugin's), such as an edit made to the record's file in the synced folder: it waits for the person's review there, and applies as theirs. Long text, the stage, the id and plugin extension fields aren't changed this way. Only the person uses it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record to change. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `fields` | dict[str, Any] | required | The new values, by field name. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The record's version the edit was made from. |

### `record.log`

Add a dated line to a project's update log. The line is dated the day it is applied.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `project` | str | required | The id of the project whose log gets the line. |
| `text` | str | required | The line to add. |

### `record.set`

Change one field of an existing record. Allowed fields: project status, phase, target, priority, summary, parent (the id of the project it belongs to), language (a tag such as en-US) and owner (a person's id); action text, due and notes; question title and text; person role, org and why_they_matter. The new value must be valid for the field. Evidence is required for due, status, owners, target and owner.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `kind` | Literal['project', 'action', 'question', 'person'] | required | The kind of record to change. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the record to change. |
| `field` | str | required | The field to set; only the fields listed for this kind are allowed. |
| `value` | Any | required | The new value, in the field's own type; a date is written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The words that justify the change; see the fields needing it. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `report.draft`

Draft a report to the product's maintainers when the PM asks for something the product can't do: what was wanted, what happens now, and why it would help. The PM reviews and sends it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `title` | str | required | One line naming what is missing. |
| `text` | str | required | The report, written for the maintainers. |

### `routing.add`

Keep a routing entry: who answers a kind of question, or who doesn't (`negative`), and where to look it up instead. Name the person or the team by id. From the person's own words it is active at once; from anything else it is a proposal the person keeps or discards.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | The entry in plain words. |
| `topic` | str | required | The topic, area or kind of question. |
| `person` | str \| None | `None` | The person's id. |
| `team` | str \| None | `None` | The team's id, instead of a person. |
| `negative` | bool | `False` | True when they don't answer this. |
| `look_up` | str \| None | `None` | Where to look it up instead, in plain words. |
| `applies_to` | Scope | see below | What it applies to. |
| `applies_to.task_kinds` | list[str] | `[]` | Task kinds it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.records` | list[str] | `[]` | Record types or type.field targets it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.filter` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Exact field values narrowing the record targets. |
| `applies_to.projects` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope projects, the projects it is for. |
| `applies_to.people` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='person')]] | `[]` | The people it is about; empty means anyone. |
| `applies_to.scope` | Literal['workspace', 'projects'] | `'workspace'` | workspace: everywhere, except the projects in `except`. projects: only the projects listed in `projects`. |
| `applies_to.except` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope workspace, the projects it does not apply to. Dumped by alias, so the key is `except`. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input it rests on, if any. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `rule.add`

Add a standing rule: an instruction the assistant follows from now on. A system op: from the person's own words the rule is active at once; from anyone else it is added as a proposal that changes nothing until the person keeps it. A rule that names a deterministic `check` can gate a stage; a rule with none is prose.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | The rule, in the person's wording. |
| `name` | str \| None | `None` | A short name other settings can refer to; made from the rule's id when left out. |
| `applies_to` | Scope | see below | What the rule applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.task_kinds` | list[str] | `[]` | Task kinds it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.records` | list[str] | `[]` | Record types or type.field targets it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.filter` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Exact field values narrowing the record targets. |
| `applies_to.projects` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope projects, the projects it is for. |
| `applies_to.people` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='person')]] | `[]` | The people it is about; empty means anyone. |
| `applies_to.scope` | Literal['workspace', 'projects'] | `'workspace'` | workspace: everywhere, except the projects in `except`. projects: only the projects listed in `projects`. |
| `applies_to.except` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope workspace, the projects it does not apply to. Dumped by alias, so the key is `except`. |
| `check` | str \| None | `None` | The id of a deterministic check that implements the rule, when one exists. |
| `constrains` | list[str] | `[]` | What the rule is about: op kinds (`question.add`) or op fields (`action.add.owners`). |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The words from the input that justify the rule, if any. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `rule.retire`

Stop following an active rule; the record stays, marked retired. A system op.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the rule, such as RULE-3. |

### `setting.propose`

Propose a change to one setting, when the answer is a setting the PM can change. Nothing changes until the PM applies it. The setting is named by its setting code from the settings list.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `setting` | str | required | The setting's code, exactly as the settings list gives it. |
| `value` | Any | required | Its new value, of the type the settings list shows for it. |
| `why` | str | required | Why this change answers the question, in one line. |

### `stage.move`

Propose entering a configured stage. Always waits for the person's confirmation.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record to move. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `to` | str | required | The id of the stage to enter. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The version of the record that was read; the move fails if it changed. |

Keep a style note: what a recipient or audience wants or avoids in what is written for them. `audience` is a person's id or a kind of audience in words. From the person's own words it is active at once; from anything else it is a proposal the person keeps or discards.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `text` | str | required | The note in plain words. |
| `audience` | str | required | A person's id, or a kind of audience in words. |
| `observation` | str | required | What they want or avoid. |
| `applies_to` | Scope | see below | What it applies to. |
| `applies_to.task_kinds` | list[str] | `[]` | Task kinds it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.records` | list[str] | `[]` | Record types or type.field targets it applies to; empty means all. |
| `applies_to.filter` | dict[str, Any] | `{}` | Exact field values narrowing the record targets. |
| `applies_to.projects` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope projects, the projects it is for. |
| `applies_to.people` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='person')]] | `[]` | The people it is about; empty means anyone. |
| `applies_to.scope` | Literal['workspace', 'projects'] | `'workspace'` | workspace: everywhere, except the projects in `except`. projects: only the projects listed in `projects`. |
| `applies_to.except` | list[Annotated[str, RefTo(kind='project')]] | `[]` | With scope workspace, the projects it does not apply to. Dumped by alias, so the key is `except`. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The exact words from the input it rests on, if any. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `text.accept`

Accept a pending version, change by change: the result becomes the field's text, with authorship following the choices. Changes not listed are accepted; rejecting every change discards it. Only the person uses it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `version` | str | required | The id of the pending text version. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The version of that record that was reviewed. |
| `choices` | dict[str, Literal['accept', 'reject']] | `{}` | Per change id (c1, c2, ...): accept or reject. |

### `text.discard`

Set a pending version aside without changing the field. Only the person uses it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `version` | str | required | The id of the pending text version. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The version of that record that was reviewed. |

### `text.draft`

The assistant's draft for a long text field, made by the core from a draft task's prose answer: a pending version for the person's review, never the field's text until accepted. Draft tasks only.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record whose field it is. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `field` | str | required | The long text field. |
| `text` | str | required | The whole drafted text. |
| `base` | int \| None | `None` | The number of the version it was made from. |
| `run` | str \| None | `None` | The AI run that wrote it. |
| `paragraph_map` | list[dict[str, Any]] | `[]` | For an anchored draft, per paragraph in order, the base units it came from: {from: [p1, ...]}. |
| `questions` | list[str] | `[]` | Questions for the person the draft ended with, shown beside it. |

### `text.edit`

The person's own new text for a long text field, written here: it becomes the field's text at once, with the person as author of every passage it changes. Only the person (an edit on screen or their own action) uses it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record whose field it is. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `field` | str | required | The long text field. |
| `text` | str | required | The whole new text. |

### `text.propose`

The person's own work on a long text field arriving from outside (a working copy handed back, a file edited elsewhere): a pending version for review, made from version `base` (the current one if unset).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record whose field it is. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `field` | str | required | The long text field. |
| `text` | str | required | The whole proposed text. |
| `base` | int \| None | `None` | The number of the version it was made from. |
| `note` | str \| None | `None` | Where it came from, for the review. |
| `unmapped` | list[str] | `[]` | What couldn't be mapped back into the text, shown beside the proposal. |
